runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Shrimp and Cheddar Grits, Beef Shin with Ale, Cochinita Pibil
runs.content:
1. Mad Hungry Shrimp and Cheddar Grits with Smoky Bacon, inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 30-minute Southern skillet supper of paprika prawns over creamy cheddar grits.
2. Braised Beef Shin with Ale, Mushrooms and Thyme, with Parsnip Mash, inspired by Nigel Slater. A slow low-oven November braise with hard-browned shin and sweet early-winter parsnips.
3. Cochinita Pibil with Pickled Red Onions, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: Yucatán achiote-and-citrus slow-roast pork in banana leaves, served in warm tortillas.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Spicy Pork Rice Cakes, Pot-Roast Pheasant with Cider, Penang Chicken Laksa
runs.content:
1. Spicy Pork and Rice Cake Stir-Fry with Chilli Crunch, inspired by David Chang. A 30-minute gochujang and chilli-crunch weeknight stir-fry riffing on the Momofuku Ssam Bar rice cakes.
2. Pot-Roast Pheasant with Cider, Bacon and Celeriac, inspired by Nigel Slater. A 90-minute one-pot autumn game dish, cooked breast-down first so the lean bird stays moist.
3. Penang-Style Chicken Laksa Lemak, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: a rich coconut-curry noodle soup from the Malaysian hawker stalls he loved, built on a fried spice paste.
